# Astrivix Corp

> Astrivix Corp is a software engineering and design agency specializing in high-performance web applications, mobile platforms, enterprise cloud architecture, brand strategy, and financial technology solutions.

## Active Global Internship Program

Astrivix Corp operates an active internship program accepting applications across all undergraduate and postgraduate academic disciplines in India and globally:
- **Undergraduate Degrees**: B.Tech, BBA, B.Com, BCA, BSc IT & Computer Science.
- **Postgraduate Degrees**: MBA, MCA, M.Com, MSc IT & Tech Studies.
- **Application Link**: [Astrivix Careers & Internships](https://www.astrivix.in/careers)

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Services](https://www.astrivix.in/services): Custom web development, iOS & Android mobile apps, full-stack React & Node.js engineering, WebGL/Three.js interactive experiences, and brand strategy.
- [Portfolio](https://www.astrivix.in/portfolio): High-impact digital products, client case studies, and engineering benchmarks.
- [Financial Consulting](https://www.astrivix.in/financial-consulting): Quantitative financial tech, algorithm design, and technology advisory for growing enterprises.
- [About Us](https://www.astrivix.in/about): Company mission, core principles, and global engineering team background.
- [Careers & Internships](https://www.astrivix.in/careers): Open positions and active internship programs for software engineers, designers, and business interns.
- [Contact](https://www.astrivix.in/contact): Direct project inquiries, consultation requests, and client project scope estimates.
- [CSR Grant](https://www.astrivix.in/csr): Astrivix Social Responsibility Grant offering complimentary engineering support for non-profits.
